chinese: 要求高的但非常值得的
今天我们要谈谈如何在外交服务领域建立成功的职业
english: Today we're going to talk about how to build a successful career in foreign service
soundmark: /təˈdeɪ wɪər ˈɡoʊɪŋ tuː tɔːk əˈbaʊt haʊ tuː bɪld ə səkˈsesfəl kəˈrɪər ɪn ˈfɒrɪn ˈsɜːrvɪs/

chinese: 首先你需要有很强的沟通技巧
english: First you need to have strong communication skills
soundmark: /fɜːrst juː niːd tuː hæv strɒŋ kəˌmjuːnɪˈkeɪʃən skɪlz/

chinese: 更重要的是你必须能够适应不同文化
english: More importantly you must be able to adapt to different cultures
soundmark: /mɔːr ɪmˈpɔːrtəntli juː mʌst biː ˈeɪbəl tuː əˈdæpt tuː ˈdɪfərənt ˈkʌltʃərz/

chinese: 你还应该准备好在整个职业生涯中不断学习
english: You should also be prepared to keep learning throughout your career
soundmark: /juː ʃʊd ˈɔːlsoʊ biː prɪˈpeərd tuː kiːp ˈlɜːrnɪŋ θruːˈaʊt jɔːr kəˈrɪər/

chinese: 最成功的人是那些从不停止提升自己的人
english: The most successful individuals are those who never stop improving themselves
soundmark: /ðə moʊst səkˈsesfəl ˌɪndɪˈvɪdʒuəlz ɑːr ðoʊz huː ˈnevər stɒp ɪmˈpruːvɪŋ ðəmˈselvz/

chinese: 他们拥抱挑战并将其视为成长的机会
english: They embrace challenges and see them as opportunities to grow
soundmark: /ðeɪ ɪmˈbreɪs ˈtʃælɪndʒɪz ænd siː ðəm æz ˌɒpərˈtjuːnɪtiz tuː ɡroʊ/

chinese: 外交服务的职业要求很高但非常值得
english: A career in foreign service is demanding but highly rewarding
soundmark: /ə kəˈrɪər ɪn ˈfɒrɪn ˈsɜːrvɪs ɪz dɪˈmɑːndɪŋ bʌt ˈhaɪli rɪˈwɔːrdɪŋ/
